facts.fact: A DGDI official said services in development will let people prove their identity without the physical card, and that the chip card could eventually allow a digital derivation on a smartphone.

GAB.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
Birth certificates are only a required document; no digital civil register is stated.
Only a general mention of strengthening digital sovereignty; no policy, rule, hosting or contract terms.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
The card is open from age 16 with parents supplying information for minors; no number at birth is stated.
Nothing on who builds, maintains or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The governor of Ogooué-Maritime launched issuance of the chip-based electronic national identity card (CNIE) in Port-Gentil on 13 December 2024, applications requiring a Personal Identification Number (NIP) attestation, through the DGDI.

GAB.note: No digital entry at civil registration offices is stated.
